definition: II. [ נַעֲרָה ] proper name, of a location on border of Ephraim — only with ה locative, נַעֲרָ֫תָה Josh 16:7 ( ᵐ5 αἱ Κῶμαι αὐτῶν ; ᵐ5 L id. + Αναραθα ); apparently = נַעֲרָן , q. v. below; Νοοραθ lay 5 Roman miles from Jericho Lag Onom. 283, 11 compare Buhl Geogr. 181 .
